newsitem.title: USA: CommNet says to merge with Blackstone unit.
newsitem.headline: CommNet says to merge with Blackstone unit.

text.p: CommNet Cellular Inc said Wednesday that it and Blackstone Capital Partners Merchant Banking Fund signed an agreement for the merger of CommNet with AV Acquisition Corp, a Delaware corporation formed by Blackstone.

The companies said the merger agreement provides that the owner of each outstanding share of CommNet common stock can elect either to receive $36 in cash for that share or to retain that share, subject to proration.
The merger is valued at about $718 million, including net indebtedness of about $200 million to be refinanced, the companies said.
On completion, Blackstone will be the majority owner of CommNet, the companies said.

The companies said the agreement provides that in no event can more than about 590,000 shares of CommNet common stock, accounting for about 4 percent of the currently outstanding shares, be retained by present CommNet shareholders.
Following the merger, the companies said affiliates of Blackstone expect to own about 87 percent of CommNet's outstanding shares.
